provenance: SEPARABLE BY CONSTRUCTION, and the accuracy on these rows should be read that way: single features reach one-vs-rest AUC 1.0000 for detector_blinding (sift_ratio, click_asymmetry), 0.9785 for intercept_resend (qber_mean) and 0.9703 for photon_number_splitting (multiphoton_rate), because the generator's _SIGNATURES table assigns each attack a distinctive value. This measures the simulator, not the world. SYNTHETIC QKD-attack telemetry generated by src/qsh/qml_ids/attacks.py. The eight classes are seven attack types plus normal traffic, a structure taken from Al-Kuwari et al. (arXiv:2509.14282); no number from that paper is reproduced here. It is synthetic because no real corpus with unambiguous commercial terms exists - UNSW-NB15 needs the authors' agreement, and the CIC's institute FAQ and its CICIDS2017 dataset page state conflicting terms. This is the whole held-out quarter of the same seed-42 draw the published model was trained against, so the figure below is the model's own test metric rather than a resample of it.
